narr: After midnight on July 14th, a line of thunderstorms moved across portions of western Wisconsin. As these storms moved over already saturated soils from storms a few hours prior, susceptible areas noted flooding and rock slides particularly in Trempealeau and Monroe Counties.
ev: Emergency management reported rock slides along County 27 between Sparta and Cashton.
Law enforcement reported flooding ongoing along Highway 95 between Arcadia and Blair.
Emergency management reported roads closed across parts of southern Monroe County due to flooding. Kendall was the most impacted by flooding at the time of this report.
